messages:
maya: Quick intake — bringing up ember-8b with int8-first quant strategy. Need perf/quality triage and a perf sweep plan. Priorities: (1) throughput/latency baseline at default batch configs, (2) ctx-length sweep up to 8k, (3) quant-quality regression vs our chat/regression evals.

sam: Got it. Any target SLOs or unit-econ goals we should gate on before advancing?

maya: Targets: p50 latency < 120ms for 512 tokens (single-request), throughput >= 250 tokens/s per GPU at batch=16 for 1024 ctx, and end-to-end regression delta on chat-regress-100 should be < 3% (human pass rate drop). If int8 drops quality >3% we try int4 fallback or tweak calibration.

nora: For quant config, are we doing per-channel scale + group-by-128? Or straight symmetric per-tensor?

maya: Start with per-channel symmetric, 8-bit, group-size=128. If quality looks poor, try NF4 / 4-bit GPTQ variant. Sample config to use for smoke:

```
quant_config:
  method: per_channel
  bits: 8
  group_size: 128
  clip_activations: true
  fallback: int4_candidate=true
```

liam: Please add the eval sets we should run and the gating metrics. I can wire them into the eval pipeline.

maya: Eval list: ["chat-regress-100", "summ-eval-5k", "eval-code-500"]. Metrics: chat human_pass_rate (threshold 90%), ROUGE-L delta < 2 absolute points on summ-eval, and exact-match drop < 1.5% on eval-code-500. Also run perplexity and PPL ratio vs fp16 baseline.

akshay: I can run the perf sweep on dedicated infra. Plan: batch sweep [1,2,4,8,16], seq-len sweep [512,1024,2048,4096,8192], warmup=400 steps, measure p50/p95 and tokens/s. Will pin to gpu-pool:d4-reserved.

bench-bot: Scheduled bench: model=ember-8b-int8 node=gpu-dedicated-4 batches=[1,2,4,8,16] ctx=[512,1024,2048,4096,8192] warmup=400 runs=3

ops-bot: note: reserve 4GB extra KV-cache disk for 8k ctx to avoid OOM on p3-class nodes.

sam: When you run, capture both continuous batching and single-request latencies, and include cache-hit vs cold-start profiles. Also capture memory usage and peak Alloc.

akshay: Running smoke now — posting short results:

```
# smoke summary (batch=8, ctx=1024)
p50: 98ms
p95: 210ms
tokens/s: 280
mem-peak: 12.1GB
quality-chat-regress-100: human_pass_rate=91.2% (delta -1.1)
```

nora: That quality number looks safe. Good sign for int8 baseline. Next: full ctx sweep and compare to fp16.

liam: I'll kick off eval pipeline after akshay uploads ARTIFACTS. Need artifact naming: ember/2026-03-20/int8-v1 with full trace.

maya: Assignments: maya -> lead quality triage, sam -> perf analysis & econometrics, akshay -> run full bench sweep & upload outputs, nora -> run additional quant variants (nf4/int4) if we see edge regressions, liam -> eval pipeline + post-run report. Timeline: try to have raw results + evals by EOD tomorrow.

sam: Sounds good. If we hit any >3% regression, flag for rollback and include exact failure prompts.

maya: thanks — ping me @maya in thread when uploads complete. :thumbsup:

bench-bot: run-complete: ember-8b-int8 / gpu-dedicated-4 — results uploaded to s3://redwood-bench/ember/2026-03-20/int8-v1/ (manifest.json + perf.csv + eval.tar.gz)

akshay: Uploaded artifacts and manifest. Starting eval-run now.

liam: Received — starting automated evals, will post summary once done.

maya: Great. We'll reconvene if anything crosses gating thresholds. Thanks all.
